items.title: Palantir (PLTR) Faces A European Rival In Defense AI
items.summary: Palantir Technologies (NasdaqGS:PLTR) faces fresh European competition as Helsing GmbH unveils its Clarity AI defense platform. Clarity is being introduced as a European controlled system designed to comply with EU sovereignty expectations and NATO interoperability standards. The German military is running trials of Helsing's Clarity AI, targeting applications in mission planning and battlefield intelligence workflows.
